mapper.sql: FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_tenant membership ON membership.user_id = u.id AND membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_tenant tenant ON tenant.id = membership.tenant_id AND tenant.tenant_status = 1 AND tenant.del_flag = 0 WHERE u.user_status = 1 AND u.del_flag = 0

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_org binding INNER JOIN sys_org org ON org.id = binding.org_id AND org.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND org.org_status = 1 AND org.del_flag = 0 WHERE binding.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND binding.user_id = u.id AND binding.org_id = #{orgId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT u.id user_id, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.real_name), ''), u.username) display_name
AND u.id IN #{userId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY u.id
